summary: 8 followers, 6 posts, 0 IG DMs. High skip rates (64-75%) show hooks fail in first 3s. Bio mentions Himachal niche and 24hr delivery — conflicts with rules. Free site check offer only allowed for website posts.
guidance:
- Rotate hook styles: try "Story" or "Contrast" next; avoid another "Question" hook (used 2/3 recent posts).
- Skip rate >60% means first 3 seconds need visual + text promise of value for any Indian small business.
- Shares high (51%) on presenter reel — keep human face + clear benefit.
- View sources: 61% feed, 24% profile — optimise caption for feed scrollers.
- Posts must read as developer sharing real work, never an ad. No demos, no niche targeting, no invented results.

instructions.research: Find 2-3 relatable Indian small-business scenarios (e.g. a Jaipur jeweller, a Kochi cafe, a Delhi coaching centre) where short animated ads could replace static posts. Note common pain points: low reach, high creative cost, slow turnaround.
instructions.analysis: Compare the two published reels: presenter clock (614 views, 51% share) vs cafe preview (783 views, 0.4% share). Presenter format drives shares; preview format drives views but not action. For AI animated ads, use presenter style with on-screen text showing ad frames.
instructions.writer: Write a 90-120 word caption: open with a visual hook line (e.g. "Static posts scroll past. Motion stops them."), show the problem generically, explain how AI animated ads work in one sentence, end with "Pay after you approve. DM to see if it fits." No niche, no guarantees, no demo offer.
instructions.image: Create a single carousel slide: left side a static post example (generic product photo), right side the same frame animated (subtle motion arrows). Caption overlay: "Same asset. Motion added. ₹X after approval." No client names, no region.
instructions.video: Record a 15-20s reel: you at desk, phone screen shows a generic static post, then the same post animates (text pops, image pans). Voiceover: "AI turns your existing creatives into short motion ads. You approve, then pay. DM me." First 3s must show the before/after side by side.

manual_tips: Update bio: remove "Himachal", "24 hrs", and "Free 2-min site check". Keep only: "Websites, AI chatbots, AI animated ads, lead gen for small businesses across India. Pay after approval. DM to chat."
Comment thoughtfully on 5 posts from Indian small-business accounts (cafes, gyms, D2C brands) — ask a genuine question about their current ad creatives, no self-promo.
Reply to the 1 comment on your latest reel (if any) with a follow-up question about their lead flow, steering toward a DM conversation.
